_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: idx_body_measurements_date
data.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_body_measurements_date ON body_measurements(date_key DESC, measured_at DESC)

data.name: idx_coin_ledger_daily_unique
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_coin_ledger_daily_unique ON coin_ledger(date_key, action_type) WHERE action_type != 'shop_buy'

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_path" TEXT NULL, "birth_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "biological_sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "weekly_goal_rate_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT -0.5, "daily_water_goal_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2500, "daily_steps_goal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8000, "daily_sleep_goal_hours" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 7.5, "current_adaptive_tdee_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2000, "last_tdee_calibration" TEXT NULL, "scale_mac_address" TEXT NULL, "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'material_you', "local_ai_model_path" TEXT NULL, "is_local_ai_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_local_ai_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_cycle_tracking_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_cycle_tracking_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_fasting_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_fasting_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_manual_macro_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_manual_macro_mode" IN (0, 1)), "manual_kcal_target" INTEGER NULL, "manual_protein_g" INTEGER NULL, "manual_carbs_g" INTEGER NULL, "manual_fat_g" INTEGER NULL, "active_diet_archetype" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flexible', "active_diet_phase" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deficit', "calorie_cycling_schedule_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "caffeine_bedtime_cutoff_hours" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 8.0, "active_diet_phase_started_at" TEXT NULL, "has_impedance_contraindication" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_impedance_contraindication" IN (0, 1)), "has_eating_disorder_history" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_eating_disorder_history" IN (0, 1)), "takes_hypoglycemic_medication" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("takes_hypoglycemic_medication" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "measured_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "trend_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "impedance_ohms" INTEGER NULL, "bmi" REAL NOT NULL, "body_fat_percentage" REAL NULL, "muscle_mass_kg" REAL NULL, "water_percentage" REAL NULL, "visceral_fat_index" INTEGER NULL, "bone_mass_kg" REAL NULL, "protein_percentage" REAL NULL, "basal_metabolic_rate_kcal" INTEGER NULL, "metabolic_age" INTEGER NULL, "lean_body_mass_kg" REAL NULL, "body_score" INTEGER NULL, "somatotype" TEXT NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NULL, "neck_cm" REAL NULL, "hip_cm" REAL NULL, "validated_body_fat_percentage" REAL NULL, "is_water_retention_spike" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_water_retention_spike" IN (0, 1)), "spike_explanation" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_summaries" ("date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active_calories_from_steps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sleep_duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sleep_deep_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sleep_rem_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "resting_heart_rate_bpm" INTEGER NULL, "water_consumed_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "calorie_target_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "protein_target_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "carbs_target_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fat_target_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hydration_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "volume_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_to_health_connect" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synced_to_health_connect" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "barcode" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "nutri_score" TEXT NULL, "nova_group" INTEGER NULL, "default_serving_grams" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 100.0, "serving_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '100g', "kcal_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sugar_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sodium_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "potassium_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "magnesium_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "calcium_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "iron_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "zinc_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vitamin_c_mg_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vitamin_d_ug_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vitamin_b12_ug_per100g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "last_used_at" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_combos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "times_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_combo_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "combo_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_combos (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id), "base_grams" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id), "grams_consumed" REAL NOT NULL, "portion_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "total_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "total_protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "total_carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "total_fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "total_fiber_g" REAL NOT NULL, "total_sodium_mg" REAL NOT NULL, "total_potassium_mg" REAL NOT NULL, "total_magnesium_mg" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fasting_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "protocol_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_end_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "actual_ended_at" TEXT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_blocks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "performed_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rpe_intensity" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_met" REAL NOT NULL, "user_weight_at_time_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "net_calories_burned" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "progress_photo_path" TEXT NULL, "mood_score" INTEGER NULL, "energy_level" INTEGER NULL, "stress_level" INTEGER NULL, "tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "ai_insight_summary" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pet_status" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "pet_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Nibi', "coins_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "current_streak_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "highest_streak_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "streak_shields_available" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "shield_active_until" TEXT NULL, "equipped_hat_id" TEXT NULL, "equipped_background_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bg_default_room', "unlocked_items_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '["bg_default_room"]', "last_ai_greeting" TEXT NULL, "last_greeting_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coin_ledger" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sleep_multiplier_applied" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "reminder_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_of_day_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "days_of_week_bitmask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 127, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "interval_minutes" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tdee_calibrations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "calibrated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_tdee_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "new_tdee_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "calculated_raw_tdee_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "was_clamped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("was_clamped" IN (0, 1)), "delta_ema14d" REAL NOT NULL, "average_kcal14d" REAL NOT NULL, "days_evaluated" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_sync_checkpoints" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "record_type" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "last_sync_timestamp" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_read_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_write_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "default_meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lunch', "total_yield_servings" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "cooked_total_weight_grams" REAL NULL, "kcal_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sodium_mg_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "potassium_mg_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "magnesium_mg_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "last_used_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recipe_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id), "raw_grams" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplements_tracker" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dosage" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_time_of_day_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "affects_water_retention" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("affects_water_retention" IN (0, 1)), "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplement_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplement_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES supplements_tracker (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "taken_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "was_taken" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("was_taken" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "female_cycle_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "cycle_start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_end_date" TEXT NULL, "cycle_length_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 28, "flow_intensity" TEXT NULL, "symptoms_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "digestive_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "bristol_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discomfort_level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "symptoms_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "caffeine_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "source_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "caffeine_mg" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "protocol_plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Mi Protocolo Semanal', "fasting_days_bitmask" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"1":16,"2":16,"3":16,"4":16,"5":16,"6":0,"7":0}', "workout_slots_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "diet_archetype" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flexible', "is_current_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_current_active" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "milestone_goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "milestone_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "estimated_completion_date" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ui_preferences" ("pref_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pref_value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pref_key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_body_measurements_date ON body_measurements (date_key DESC, measured_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_hydration_logs_date ON hydration_logs (date_key, logged_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_logs_date_meal ON food_logs (date_key, meal_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_logs_food_item ON food_logs (food_item_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_fasting_sessions_started ON fasting_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_blocks_date ON workout_blocks (date_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_journal_entries_date ON journal_entries (date_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_coin_ledger_daily_unique ON coin_ledger (date_key, action_type) WHERE action_type != 'shop_buy'
CREATE INDEX idx_recipes_name ON recipes (name)
CREATE INDEX idx_supplement_logs_date ON supplement_logs (date_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_digestive_logs_date ON digestive_logs (date_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_caffeine_logs_date ON caffeine_logs (date_key)
